summary: Bottom trawl nets towed by motorised/mechanised boats banned: no use, possession, import, transport, purchase or sale; no new licences.
legal_basis: FARA s.28A, inserted by Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (Amendment) Act No. 11 of 2017
notes: Certified 25.07.2017. Penalty up to 2 years and/or fine ≥ Rs 50,000.

summary: Explosives, poison, stupefying substances (incl. dynamite) banned for fishing; no possession or trade in fish caught this way.
legal_basis: FARA s.27 (as amended by Act No. 4 of 2004)
notes: gazette_date = Act No. 2 of 1996 certification date (approx.)

summary: Monofilament nets: no use, possession, import, transport, purchase or sale for fishing.
legal_basis: Monofilament Nets Prohibition Regulations

summary: Spear guns and hand-held spears banned for fishing; spear guns may not be possessed or carried on local boats.
legal_basis: Prohibition of Use of Spears in Fishing Operations Regulations No.1 of 2017

summary: No artificial light to attract fish (DG may permit for small-scale rod & line, scoop net, hand line, traps). Light limits on boats; no generators on NTRB/MTRB/NBSB/OFRP/IDAY.
gears_banned_or_limited: light attraction; generators on small boats
legal_basis: Fishing Operations Regulations 1996 (Amendment) reg. 9(3)-(6)

summary: Diving fishing operations only 06:00–18:00; separate licence per target type; scuba boats max 2 divers + skipper and ≤8 cylinders; no harpoons/spears on chank, bêche-de-mer, lobster and ornamental scuba boats.
legal_basis: Fishing Operations Regulations 1996 (Amendment) Part II regs 11-18

summary: Stake nets (ja kottu) not near coral reefs, seagrass, marine-mammal habitat or beach-seine areas; guide net ≤ 75 m, mesh ≥ 1.25 in; ≥ 300 m apart.
legal_basis: Fishing Operations Regulations 1996 (Amendment) Part III regs 20-26

summary: No licence holder may catch lobster anywhere in the Sri Lanka sea area in February, September and October.
legal_basis: FARA s.34 notice: Declaration of prohibited time period for lobster
notes: DFAR register lists 2009-05-05; the gazette masthead reads FRIDAY, MAY 15, 2009 (signed 04.05.2009).

summary: No dredging or trawling to take chank (live or dead); DG may declare closed seasons/areas.
legal_basis: Chank Fisheries Management and Export Regulations 2003

summary: No mechanised dredging for dead shells; dead-shell collection, possession and transport need a licence.
legal_basis: Fisheries Management (Collection of dead shells) Regulations 2012

summary: Blue swimming crab: only with an operation licence; nylon polyfilament nets only; bottom-set gillnet mesh ≥ 4.5 in, ply ≤ 6; OFRP/MTRB/NTRB only; no dredging or seabed damage.
legal_basis: Blue Swimming Crab Fishery Management Regulations 2022

summary: Mud crab fishing only with an operation licence; no dredging or habitat damage.
legal_basis: Mud Crab Fishery Management Regulations 2024

summary: Every mechanised fishing boat needs a departure and arrival permit for each trip; AIS/MMSI required.
legal_basis: Departure and Arrival of Mechanized Fishing Boats Regulations No.1 of 2023

summary: No fishing anywhere in Sri Lanka Waters without a licence under the Fishing Operations Regulations 1996.
legal_basis: Fishing Operations Regulations 1996 reg. 9(2) (inserted 2019)

summary: Recreational fishing needs a licence. Catch may not be sold; ETP species must be released; no stainless hooks; none in closed seasons, spawning/breeding areas or MPAs (DFAR/DWC).
legal_basis: Recreational Fishing Management Regulations 2023

summary: No effluent discharge, dumping or reclamation harming aquatic resources; no mangrove removal; no activity threatening fish conservation without a DG permit.
legal_basis: Conservation of Fish and Aquatic Resources within Sri Lanka Waters Regulations 2016

summary: No surrounding nets within 7 miles (6.08 NM / 11.26 km) of the coast.
gears_banned_or_limited: surrounding net (incl. purse seine, ring net)
legal_basis: Fishing Operations Regulations 1996 (Amendment) reg. 9(7)

summary: No purse-seine net (with or without light) within 7 miles of shore; outside that, permit required; net ≤ 225 m, mesh ≥ 3/8 in, lamps ≤ 1,500 W (tuna purse seines exempt from length/lamp limits).
legal_basis: Purse-Seine Net Fishing Regulations 1986
notes: Made under the Fisheries Ordinance (Cap. 212), repealed by FARA 1996; whether it is saved was not verified. Largely overtaken by 2115/8.

summary: No purse-seine net within 10 miles of shore (Gampaha, Puttalam, Mannar, Mullaitivu, Jaffna).
legal_basis: Purse-Seine Net Fishing Regulations 1986
notes: Same caveat as the 7-mile band.

summary: Scuba collection of chank and bêche-de-mer only beyond 4 NM (7.4 km).
legal_basis: Fishing Operations Regulations 1996 (Amendment) reg. 14

summary: Trincomalee: scuba collection of chank and bêche-de-mer only beyond 2 NM (3.7 km).
legal_basis: Fishing Operations Regulations 1996 (Amendment) reg. 14 proviso

summary: Spiny lobster here only with a licence endorsed "valid for the taking of south coast spiny lobster".
legal_basis: Lobster Fisheries Management Regulations 2000 reg. 2

summary: No spiny-lobster fishing in February and September (2000 rule; nationwide Feb/Sep/Oct closure added in 2009).
legal_basis: Lobster Fisheries Management Regulations 2000 reg. 3

summary: Banned: trawl, push net, moxi net, gill/trammel nets on coral reefs or rocks, digging polychaete worms. Licences must be endorsed for Negombo Lagoon.
gears_banned_or_limited: trawl; push net; moxi net; gill/trammel net on reefs
legal_basis: Negombo Lagoon FMA Regulations 1998 reg. 3-4

summary: All fishing banned within 150 m of the lagoon shores and islands except stake nets, cast nets, crab traps, small shrimp nets, rod/handline, manual traps and eel traps.
legal_basis: Negombo Lagoon FMA Regulations 1998 reg. 8

summary: Trammel (disco) nets only 18:00–06:00; ≤ 600 m of head-rope per operation.
legal_basis: Negombo Lagoon FMA Regulations 1998 reg. 5-7

summary: Residents only; cast nets and drift nets only, plus ≤ 25 jakotuwa (no new ones); mesh ≥ 3 in for fish and ≥ 3/4 in for prawns; net ≤ 145 m; no mechanised craft; drift nets only in Maha Eliya; permit required.
gears_banned_or_limited: all nets except cast/drift; mechanised craft
legal_basis: Rekawa Lagoon FMA Regulations 1998

summary: No trap nets or drag nets; no drift nets with mesh < 5.1 cm (2 in).
gears_banned_or_limited: trap net; drag net; drift net <2 in
legal_basis: Old Dutch Canal and Mundal Lagoon Fishing Regulations 1996

summary: Harasdel only from 1 mile south of Chilaw Bridge, ≥ 100 m apart, mesh ≥ 4 cm (1.5 in). Management plan 2024 adds further measures (not parsed).
legal_basis: Chilaw Lagoon Fisheries Regulations 1996; Chilaw Lagoon plan

summary: Drag net (karaivalai/madel) banned in the area; drift nets < 3 in banned in Sector 2; no new kottus/enclosures without committee approval.
legal_basis: Fishery Management (Batticaloa Lagoon) Regulations 2001

summary: Only Second-Schedule gears (madel, ahuranadel, ketayapanna, maruwel panna, cast nets, lobster nets); drift nets only > 375 m from Hambiyawa; lobster only in specified waraya; madel only Jan–Mar and no nylon nets.
legal_basis: Fisheries Management (Matara District, Thotamuna, Ginigasmulla) Regulations 2000

summary: Rod and line only.
legal_basis: Nilwella Fisheries Regulations No.1 of 2011

summary: Cuttlefish FADs only > 8 km offshore at ≥ 16 m depth, deployed Jan–Mar only, ≤ 10 per boat per week; GPS-registered; no surface buoys.
legal_basis: Cuttlefish fishing regulations (Udappuwa & Semuthu Thoduwa)

summary: Live ornamental fish/lobster only with an endorsed licence; ≤ 20/25 gillnet pieces; 06:00–18:00 only.
legal_basis: Regulations 2012

summary: Chank/lobster only with an endorsed licence (one per category); gillnet limits; logbooks.
legal_basis: Regulations 2012

summary: Declared Fishery Management Area (s.31); no area-specific regulations found in the DFAR register.
legal_basis: FARA s.31(1)(a) Order

summary: All fishing prohibited in the charted area off Gampaha, April 2011 to 31 March 2013.
legal_basis: FARA s.34 notices

summary: Mesh ≥ 4 in; nets of 2.5 in+ mesh may not be used for prawns in Aug–Sep; no mechanised boats.
legal_basis: Bolgoda Reservoir (Fishing Operations) Regulations 2007

summary: Gill nets only, mesh ≥ 4 in (101.6 mm); no fishing 09:00–15:00.
legal_basis: Parakrama Samudraya FMA Regulations 2002
